name: Neo4j Cypher MCP server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C2, C4, C7; partly meets C1, C3, C5, C6, C8, C9, C10.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for mcp-neo4j-cypher 0.6.0 lists no project or repository URL; the repository's `servers/mcp-neo4j-cypher/pyproject.toml` declares the package name `mcp-neo4j-cypher`. PyPI holds no provenance attestation for the release (the integrity record returned HTTP 404).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived. The latest release is 218 days old (more than 180); repository activity falls within the last 180 days. Latest release 0.6.0 is dated 2026-04-10; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-09-09; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-09-09.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 2 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list for mcp-neo4j-cypher; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (0.6.0). Most recent: GHSA-x3cv-r3g3-fpg9 (low, published 2026-04-17, patched in 0.6.0).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The write tool is available unless read-only mode is set. Quoted: “**Availability**: May be disabled by supplying --read-only as cli flag or `NEO4J_READ_ONLY=true` environment variable”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Environment variables are the preferred route; passing the password as a command-line argument is also documented. Quoted: “Syntax with `--db-url`, `--username`, `--password`, `--read-timeout` and other command line arguments is still supported but environment variables are preferred:”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `servers/mcp-neo4j-cypher/README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`servers/mcp-neo4j-cypher/uv.lock`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README has security guidance for the HTTP transport; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content returned by tools. Quoted: “Malicious websites cannot trick browsers into accessing your local server”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: fastmcp<2.14,>=2.10.5. Lower-bound version 2.10.5 of fastmcp (PyPI) was published on 2025-07-11, between 12 and 24 months before 2026-11-14.
